title: Fall Hackathon ZETA
description: The local Fall Hackathon ZETA deployment: an official CALM Hub backend, a patched UI proxy, MongoDB, and three diagram-lens services.

nodes.name: Demo user
nodes.description: An architect or platform engineer who opens the local demo, selects a lens, and explores a named view.

nodes.name: Web browser
nodes.description: The browser loads the patched Hub UI and sends same-origin API requests through the local UI proxy.

nodes.name: Patched Hub UI proxy
nodes.description: Nginx serves the locally patched React bundle with the drill-down badge, Key and Notes controls, and expanded JSON viewer. It forwards API requests to the official Hub backend.

nodes.name: CALM Hub backend
nodes.description: The unmodified official finos/calm-hub:main image. It stores architectures, serves the CALM API, loads extension manifests from the shared volume, and proxies lens requests.

nodes.name: MongoDB
nodes.description: The official Hub backend's local MongoDB 8 data store. The zeta-mongo-data Docker volume keeps its data between runs.

nodes.name: CALM Views lens
nodes.description: The local calm-views extension reads the named sidecar views, draws filtered graphs in Hub, serves the POC screen, and exports SVG or PNG files.

nodes.name: FINOS C4 lens
nodes.description: The official C4 diagram-lens service. Hub calls it on the Compose network to draw C4 views of an architecture.

nodes.name: FINOS EA Layers lens
nodes.description: The official ArchiMate Layers diagram-lens service. Hub calls it on the Compose network to draw business, application, and technology layers.

nodes.name: Extension registry volume
nodes.description: The calm-extensions Docker volume. Views, C4, and EA Layers write their extension.json and notation.json files here; Hub reads the volume when it starts.

nodes.name: Hub data volume
nodes.description: The zeta-mongo-data Docker volume stores architecture headers and versions for the local Hub demo.

nodes.name: Demo architecture files
nodes.description: The four CALM models seeded into Hub: KYC onboarding, eCH-0122, the multi-cloud landing zone, and this local demo architecture.

nodes.name: Named view sidecars
nodes.description: The *.calm-view.json selections in poc/views. The CALM Views service reads these files without changing the architecture models.

nodes.name: Hub seed script
nodes.description: scripts/seed-hub.mjs runs on the developer host during make hub-up. It loads the four model files through the local API proxy and writes their assigned Hub IDs to .local/hub-models.env.

nodes.name: Hub UI build stage
nodes.description: A Node 26 Docker build stage fetches the pinned CALM Hub UI source, applies the local view-lens-ui.patch, runs the UI tests, and produces static assets for the Nginx proxy. It does not compile the Hub server.

nodes.name: Docker Compose runtime
nodes.description: The six local containers and two named volumes started by docker-compose.yml. The Hub API remains the official FINOS image; the UI proxy is a separate local container.

flows.name: Open the local demo
flows.description: A user opens the patched UI, which sends API requests to the official Hub backend and reads stored architecture data.

The browser requests the local Hub interface.
The UI proxy forwards the request to Hub.
Hub reads the stored architecture data.

flows.description: make hub-up runs the seed script, which loads the four model files into the Hub through the UI proxy.

Forward the seed requests to the Hub API.
Store the seeded architecture versions in MongoDB.

Send the selected architecture request to Hub.
Send the architecture to the CALM Views lens.
Resolve the named view from its sidecar.
